The '''Stygian Caldera''' was a large [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] that surrounded the [[Sith Worlds/Legends|Sith Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. As it acted as a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspatial]] breakwater, it was difficult to navigate, and protected the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] from attack.

==History==
It was not until [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Pultimo]] ordered a [[Post–Great Hyperspace War counterinvasion|counterinvasion]] of the region in the aftermath of the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]] that the Caldera failed to shelter the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TEA" />

It was far easier pass through the Caldera from the outside into Sith [[Realspace/Legends|Space]] than the other way around, which brought a variety of beings into Sith Space during the time of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]], such as [[Human/Legends|Humans]] from the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], and other various [[Species/Legends|aliens]] such as the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]]. These people were integrated into the Sith society.

==Behind the scenes==
The Stygian Caldera was first depicted in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].
